author: RiotShielder
message:
Today I've updated the LiveMap to have a greater visual quality.

Firstly, it now renders using the server texture pack; PureBD craft. It also renders in a much higher resolution, and allows you to zoom further in. Other various improvements have been added as well.

The Main World and Spawn have double the resolution of the Nether and End. The Main World and Spawn also show day and night.
